g.text: Walkthrough: 8 steps from git push to production
Yellow = CI (GitHub Actions) Green = CD (Git + ArgoCD) Red box = the real file in this repo. Read 1 -> 8 (snake).
validate: # helm lint + kubeconform, every env
e2e: # throwaway kind cluster + policy tests
run: npm ci && npm run lint && npm test
5) hand over { app, tag, digest, new_release }
CI: 0.2.0 not in registry -> tag the build
plan: # qa tag + digest, verify in GHCR
# admission policy: kubectl edit is DENIED
ONE-TIME BY HAND: make up -> kind + ArgoCD + kubectl apply -f gitops-config/argocd/bootstrap/root-app.yaml
After that every change reaches the cluster through Git only. Details: docs/manual-steps.md | docs/automation-steps.md
